variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by a union in the colony.
variants.body:
A union has called a strike in {colony}. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

The gazette records the call without presuming its subsequent course. A declared strike and an account of actual work stoppages are not interchangeable notices. The public record should also avoid attributing particular terms to the dispute where those terms have not been supplied as part of the reported event.

We support {target} in this assessment. A call for collective action deserves a fair account, and the existence of conflict does not establish that every accusation against a participant is justified. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.sub: The colony has a union call for strike action.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
